name: Мат турою і конем
description:
A rook and a knight can make checkmate if they work together. How to do that, you will learn in this lesson.

Take a look at the examples. You will learn two familiar mating patterns: the Arabian mate in example 1 and Anastasia’s mate in example 2.

 

What do you have to do?

Make a checkmate with your rook and knight.

examples.text:
This is a mate from close by.
The rook attacks the king and the knight protects the rook.
But that is not the knight’s only task!
The knight also removes the red escape square from the king.

This checkmate is called the Arabian mate.

This is a checkmate from a distance. The rook attacks the king and the knight prevents him from escaping.

Note: if you want to checkmate the king from a distance, you always need help from an enemy piece. Without that black pawn, the king could escape.

This mate also has a name: Anastasia’s mate.
Now the roles of the knight and rook have been reversed. The knight attacks the king and the rook takes off the king's flight squares! Here too, a black pawn stands in the way of the king.

texts: Mate in 1! Use the coordination between your rook and knight.
